Shell(node -e  require('dotenv').config({ path: '.env.local' }); const { createClient } = require('@libsql/client'); const db = createClient({ url: process.env.TURSO_DATABASE_URL, authToken: process.env.TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN }); (async()=>{ const cols = await db.execute("SELECT name FROM pragma_table_info('user_sessions')"); const has = cols.rows.some(r=>r.name==='last_heartbeat'); if (has) { console.log('already has last_heartbeat, nothing to do'); db.close(); return; } const tx = await db.transaction('write'); try { await tx.execute('ALTER TABLE user_sessions ADD COLUMN last_heartbeat INTEGER'); await tx.execute('UPDATE user_sessions SET last_heartbeat = COALESCE(last_heartbeat, session_start) WHERE last_heartbeat IS NULL'); await tx.commit(); console.log('ALTER + backfill committed'); } catch(e) { try{await tx.rollback()}catch{}; throw e; } const chk = await db.execute("SELECT name FROM pragma_table_info('user_sessions')"); console.log('now columns:', chk.rows.map(r=>r.name).join(', ')); db.close(); })().catch(e=>console.log('ERR:', e.message.split('\n')[0])))
